pages.text: Chapter 1 power is modest. Early quests give you a $(l)Spectre Coil$() and a $(l)Thermoelectric Generator$().$(li)$(l)Thermoelectric Generator$() (water + lava): about 30 RF/t. It only produces if it has somewhere to push the power.

$(li)$(l)Tech Reborn Water Mills$(): surround them with water.$(li)$(l)Numismatic Dynamo with the Lapidary augment$(): the community favourite. Once the dragon-heart EMC loop is running, diamonds will run your dynamos for hours.

They'll carry you to your first Extreme Reactors turbine in Chapter 2.$(li)Compression dynamos with spark plugs and steam → diesel are also options.$(li)Pink Generators appear in pink buildings, but they $(l)disintegrate when mined$().

$(l)Mid-game option (pyrotheum setup, ~16k RF/t):$() a Pulverizer crushes blaze rods, a crafter makes pyrotheum dust, and one Magma Crucible melts it to feed about 28 Magmatic Dynamos (isentropic reservoir + 2 auxiliary transmission coils each), all with Signalum upgrades.
Don't pipe lava into a Magmatic Dynamo through its red coil side; that side is energy only.
